arguments.command:
cd /workspace && rm -rf submission/__pycache__ && find submission -maxdepth 2 -printf '%y %p %s\n' | sort && python3 - <<'PY'
import os,stat
base='submission';total=0;entries=0;links=0;hard=0
for r,ds,fs in os.walk(base):
    entries += len(ds)+len(fs)
    for f in fs:
        p=os.path.join(r,f);st=os.lstat(p);total+=st.st_size
        if stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode):links+=1
        if st.st_nlink>1:hard+=1
print('total bytes',total,'entries',entries,'symlinks',links,'hardlinks',hard)
PY
